subsetPolicyRationale: `s.process.process3d@1` is this plugin's own self-contained 3D manufacturing process document — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (create-step, delete-step, rename-step, change-step-enabled, change-step-origin, replace-step-measure, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field or entity it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
